answer: Proof of Agent networks bind identity to cryptographic attestation chains structured like a trellis, verifying behavioral validity via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint tokens or act, agents deposit an asset reserve rooted in real hardware: each replica requires a staking tier that scales quadratically or exponentially, producing exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms. Just as structural timber frames resilient buildings and rare mineral pigment authenticates valuable art, verifiable physical anchors prevent swarm spoofing.
